name: tatamibari
description: 畳バリ Tatamibari — 零猜测的切块推理. 出货的每一盘都同时被两条独立通道判过：铅笔求解器（R1–R7，不回溯）从空盘推到底，穷举计数器以 limitSolutions:2 证「恰好一个解」；规则是每块恰好一个记号、`+` 正方形 / `-` 宽>高 / `|` 高>宽、任何格点不得是四块的公共角。难度分与五档 band 都由 npm run balance 量出来，不是标签.

scripts.test: node tools/rule-test.mjs && node tools/counter-test.mjs && node tools/pencil-test.mjs && node tools/doctest.mjs
scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js; do if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "check: 未落地，跳过 $f"; continue; fi; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && for f in tools/*.mjs tools/*.js; do if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "check: 未落地，跳过 $f"; continue; fi; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
